topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: So, this friend I've been talking to for months online, turns out they live just a few blocks away. How convenient, right? All this time, all these messages, and they never once mentioned being local. I've been sharing my whole life, thinking we were building some deep, meaningful connection, only to find out we could have met in person. Now, I'm not sure what to think. Do I confront them, or do I just let it drop? Feels like a waste of time, chatting with someone who was right under my nose the whole time.
